summary: Pan American Silver Corp. filed a Form 6-K with interim financial statements, MD&A, CEO/CFO certificates, and a Q2 2026 earnings news release. The filing reports financial results, including revenue of $1,124M for Q2 and $2,278M for H1 2026, and net earnings of $305M and $761M, respectively. It contains no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or management change. This is a routine periodic earnings disclosure by a foreign private issuer, equivalent to a standard quarterly report, so no special-situations category applies. Watch for operational updates or capital allocation decisions in the MD&A or future filings.
